title: AI Agents Wrote 55,000 Lines and Built a Real FPS Game
description:
55,000 lines of code. Zero asset files. 🔥

Matt Shumer put a fleet of AI agents on one task: build a browser FPS from scratch. They shipped Claude of Duty on GitHub, a real first person shooter.

No images, no sound files in the repo at all. Every texture and every sound is drawn and played by code itself ✨ Procedural generation, the whole thing.

It actually works 😅

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
